outcome.technical: Optional meta.skillPins {name: {sha256, source?}} added to the schema, the vocabulary (KNOWN_META) and _manifest_rules._check_meta (finding rules.meta.skill-pins per malformed pin). One reader in plugins/audit/scripts/status/_skill_places.py beside resolve_skill: skill_digest (SHA-256 over the sorted '<relative posix path> <sha256>' lines of every file under the skill's directory; a file with no NUL byte has CRLF read as LF; no digest for an unreadable file, a link out of the directory, a link to a directory, a name holding a line break, more than MAX_SKILL_FILES files or MAX_SKILL_BYTES bytes), pin_verdict (match | mismatch | not-found | unreadable, each with the path read, the places looked in and both digests), stop_words (restore the pinned bytes, or review the diff and re-pin; dropping the pin is never offered), pin_shape_problems, pin_stops, require_pins (raises PinStop, a ValueError, so the drive's existing catch makes it a stop) and pin_flags. Every hand-out site asks it: audit-lookup.py skills_lines and review_skill_lines (write_brief turns PinStop into E_REFUSED with no brief written, so next relays a stop before any dispatch mark), drive-phase.py session_skills and runner_review_skill (dispatch() asks session_skills before the dispatch mark on the session route; writer_argv adds one --skill-pin NAME=DIGEST per pinned name handed out), and run-agent-session.py --skill-pin, checked against the session's own tree before claude starts, refusing with E_USAGE, the exit a missing skill gets. A plan without the key composes the same brief byte for byte past the timestamp line (spb1) and the session argv carries no --skill-pin (spd6). spd1 derives every function under scripts/ and hooks/ whose own body calls resolve_skills or resolve_review_skill and fails any that neither asks (require_pins/pin_stops in its own body) nor is exempt with a reason; spd2 proves it can fail. Documents: COMPATIBILITY.md lists the key under not-yet-promised (experimental) with the narrowing for a plan that already carried an unread key of that name; SECURITY.md gains a section of four limits; README meta table row; CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md sections and the regenerated module-map lines for the two new edges. Tests: test__skill_places 38/38, test_run_agent_session 113/113, test_audit_lookup 215/215, test__manifest_rules 185/185, test_drive_phase 1061 (spn-block 8/8); the task gate sweep exit 0, 5/5 files ok, 1614 cases. Mutation probe (scratchpad sg2.14/mutations.py, on a copy of the tree, anchors asserted to match once, __pycache__ purged): the five mutations the task names and an over-fire twin of each, all caught. End-to-end probe (sg2.14/drive_probe.py) on the real commands: next dispatches on a match, stops on one changed byte with the stop's words and no dispatch line, the runner refuses with exit 2 and the stub claude is never started, and after the bytes are restored next dispatches. Two files widened into the task's scope by the orchestrator: plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/_manifest_vocab.py (KNOWN_META gains skillPins - without it every plan carrying the key draws an unknown-key warning and the schema/vocab drift check reports the schema property unknown) and tools/demo/gen-demo-manifest.py (one SCHEMA_EXEMPTIONS row for meta.skillPins with its reason: experimental, read by no rendered surface, and a generated fixture has no skill directory to pin - the orchestrator's unrecorded gate had been red on tests/test_gen_demo_manifest.py for exactly that missing row; that suite is now green through the sweep, 138 cases, and check-rendered-artifacts.py --before-commit exits 0, so the row changes no generated byte). The proof command is narrowed to the four fast suites because the sweep runs only whole files and test_drive_phase whole exceeds the helper's deadline; spd1-spd8 were watched red by hand on HEAD's code (spd1, spd2, spd4-spd8 red, the allow case spd3 green) in the scratchpad's sg2.14/red_against_head.2.out, which also shows the strengthened rap6 red on HEAD's code.
outcome.descriptive: A skill the plan pins in meta.skillPins is handed to an agent's brief or a headless session only when the copy the resolver finds is the pinned bytes; otherwise no brief, no session and no dispatch line, with words that say restore or re-pin.
